title: Integrate European bounded range lookup
changes: Publish an independent 11-record range lookup as engine.bounded-range-lookup in EUR e161-d160, preserving opaque bytes and the original guest-side scan and writes.
Serve the 88 source bytes through typed ROM reads and compose boundary reads with existing owners or raw ROM.
validation: Windows GNU build e161-range-lookup-build-fix2-zlxh65v6 and Wine unit e161-range-lookup-wine-t2mh2ei8 passed publication/reuse, preservation of all 103 prior resources, poisoned-source and boundary reads, source guards and 46 original-scan state/clock comparisons.

The first build 1zxknk54 failed on three missing size-check arguments; the first correction _0ta2f6l had a syntax error. The corrected build and Wine unit passed; a nonfatal D-Bus diagnostic was emitted and the server drained.

Production Windows build e161-range-lookup-cli-build-hwt3v892 and Wine unit e161-range-lookup-cli-wine-emoffrjv passed dataset creation, reuse and verification against all 105 tested files; the 11-frame world-map input read four indexed-graphics context bytes and zero range or substitution callback bytes.
limitations: Generated dispatch may fall back to interpretation. Ordinary use, broader Wine regressions, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurement.
